title: UX Friction Killers
facebook_comment_text: Beyond just fewer fields, the *timing* of backend validation often introduces critical friction. A user shouldn't discover a typo in their email *after* filling 10 other fields. Inline, real-time feedback is non-negotiable for enterprise-level conversions. 💡 What's the biggest 'technical debt' related to UX friction your team is currently battling?
